# ataila_certificates (Data Source)

The TLS certificates of the domains, in id order: host name, issuer, expiry and renewal state. Never a key. Filters combine with AND.

Needs `certificates-read-global`; a tenant-scoped token reads its own tenant's projects' certificates. Platform release 1.0.400 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Certificates that need attention.
data "ataila_certificates" "expiring" {
  status = "expiring"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Only this project's.
- `status` (String) Only certificates in this status: `valid`, `expiring`, `expired`, `rotation_failed` or `revoked`.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) The matching certificates, in id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `auto_rotate` (Boolean) True when the platform renews it before it expires.
- `challenge_type` (String) `dns-01` or `http-01`.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded.
- `expires_at` (String) When it expires.
- `fqdn` (String) The host name it covers, e.g. `shop.example.com` or `*.example.com`.
- `id` (String) The certificate's id.
- `issued_at` (String) When it was issued (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `issuer` (String) `letsencrypt`, `zerossl`, `self-signed` or `commercial`.
- `last_renewal_attempt` (String) When a renewal was last tried.
- `project_id` (String) The project whose domain it covers; null for a domain no project owns.
- `status` (String) `valid`, `expiring`, `expired`, `rotation_failed` or `revoked`.
